paper_title: Search for galactic axions with a high-Q dielectric cavity
notes: QUAX–aγ haloscope search for galactic axions at mass ~42.8 µeV using high-Q dielectric cavity. The paper reports an exclusion limit g_agamma < 0.731 × 10^-13 GeV^-1 at 90% CL in the mass range 42.8210–42.8223 µeV (width ~1.32 neV). The limit is encoded as a horizontal line spanning the stated mass range. Local DM density ρ_a = 0.45 GeV/cm³ is used in the haloscope signal calculation (Eq. 4). The measurement includes efficiency correction (factor ~3) from Monte Carlo simulation of the Savitzky-Golay filter. System noise temperature was 17.3 ± 1 K due to cryo HEMT malfunction. No signal excess above 5σ was observed. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.95, 2))
